propositions: A detached compaction sweep that dies between rename and commit leaves the tracker working tree dirty (tracked deletions and untracked snapshots), causing subsequent reconverge union merges to abort and strand local ticket commits

The operation-linked compaction fold performs snapshot-write, retire-rename, and git commit as separate steps with no rollback or crash-atomicity boundary, making it vulnerable to failures that leave partial mutations

An intent journal must be written before any store mutation begins, and recovery must discriminate between landed folds (snapshot in HEAD), abandoned partial folds (uncommitted artifacts), and superseded folds (snapshot gone from disk)
Incomplete rollback of a fold must retain the uncommitted snapshot rather than delete it, to avoid losing folded events; the retained state is flagged as SNAPSHOT_INCONSISTENT for fsck repair

Transient git probe failures (index.lock contention, timeout) must be distinguished from snapshot-absent conditions during recovery to prevent misclassifying a transient fault as a landed fold and wrongly reverting it
Each fold must commit as a single atomic unit inside its own locked section, and recovery must run as a preamble at sweep entry to converge abandoned folds before the next batch begins
